summary_en: Tokai Rika authorized acquisition of up to 2,600,000 shares (2.9% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥8.6 billion via ToSTNeT-3 between October 29 and December 31, 2026. All acquired shares will be cancelled.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, Tokai Rika's board of directors authorized the acquisition and subsequent cancellation of up to 2,600,000 shares of its own common stock. The acquisition will be conducted through ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange) between October 29 and December 31, 2026, with a maximum outlay of ¥8.6 billion. The acquired shares represent 2.9% of outstanding shares as of September 30, 2026 (86,756,053 shares excluding treasury stock).

The company stated that this share buyback and cancellation plan is designed to expand shareholder returns in line with its medium-term management plan, Tokai Rika Vision 2030. All shares acquired under this program will be cancelled. The actual number of shares to be cancelled will be announced following completion of the acquisition phase.
